instruction: I need to make all text in my Impress presentation bold for emphasis. How can I apply bold formatting to all text boxes without selecting them one by one?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making all text in a 28-slide presentation bold. Evaluator checks if all text runs have bold formatting applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly iterates through entire presentation structure (slides → shapes → text_frames → paragraphs → runs)
Properly checks run.font.bold attribute for each text run
Filters out empty text runs to avoid false positives
Metric correctly evaluates the all_bold flag from getter
Postconfig saves file with Ctrl+S to persist changes
Complete coverage: evaluator checks ALL text in presentation as required by instruction
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts bold status → metric checks all_bold flag
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Edge case handling for empty presentations returns False instead of True (vacuous truth). However, this is unlikely to occur with the actual 28-slide presentation and doesn't affect practical verification.
